value.rationale: The claim establishes an infinite natural sharp-boundary subfamily of a published open conjecture on normal bundles of rational curves in Grassmannians. It begins with the first dimension \\(\\operatorname{Gr}(2,7)\\) excluded from Cao's partial result. For all k, the degree satisfies q1+q2=(2-r1)(3k-1-r2)+1, precisely the first integer beyond a structural obstruction. The explicit Veronese-block mechanism and uniform normal exact sequence are mathematically motivated; the result is not a free renaming or a mere sample table. It does not attempt to solve the conjecture in other ranges.
